links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT vs physician answers to TFESI patient questions across seven indices
links.effect: ChatGPT answers had significantly lower FRES and higher scores on all other readability indices, indicating greater complexity and requiring a higher education level than physician answers.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT's answers had significantly lower FRES scores, reflecting reduced reading ease, and higher scores across all other readability indices, indicating greater linguistic complexity and lower accessibility.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o vs fellowship-trained physicians on accuracy, empathy, and readability for patient education regarding TFESIs without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
